rule: The game never renders the family name, the father's name, or the mother's name, in any form or medium. The protagonist knows all three; the player never finds out.

dodge_sites.where: Act 0, the parents arguing through the door

dodge_sites.must_contain: Same last name as one of the hardware guys

dodge_sites.method: redacted line in an otherwise normal document

forbidden_renderings.why: An earlier draft printed the father's initial. Nothing about him is printed.
